meta.title: Check a suspicious contact: Cybercrime Report & Track
meta.description: Check whether a phone number, email, website, UPI ID, or other contact has been reported by others.

title: Check a suspicious contact
subtitle: See whether a phone number, email, website, UPI ID, or other identifier has been reported before. This does not prove anyone did anything wrong. It only shows what other people have told us.
sidebarTrustTitle: Why this is safe to use
syntheticNoticeTitle: This checker uses demo data, not a real national database
syntheticNoticeBody: This is a hackathon prototype. Results below come from a small, fake sample dataset, never a real telecom, bank, or government threat feed. See <link>what's real vs mocked</link>.

result.clearBody: Nobody has reported this to us. That doesn't guarantee it's safe. It may just mean no one has reported it yet.
result.limitedBody: One person has reported this. A single report isn't proof of wrongdoing. People sometimes report by mistake, or over a genuine dispute unrelated to fraud.
result.multipleBody: More than one person has reported this. That's worth being cautious about, though it's still not proof. Verify independently before you trust or pay this contact.
result.highBody: A high number of people have reported this. Treat it as a strong warning sign and avoid sending money or sharing personal information.
result.reportCount: {count, plural, =0 {No reports} one {# report} other {# reports}} on file

report.button: I want this on record too, without filing a full report
report.done: Recorded. Thank you. This adds to what others will see when they check this.

nextStepsBody: If you've already lost money or shared sensitive details, don't wait for this check to confirm anything. File a report now.
notAProofTitle: This is not proof of guilt
notAProofBody: A report reflects what someone told us, not a verified finding. Nothing here has been confirmed by an investigator.
